summary: Independent review complete: all seven proposed facts supported by owned canonical citations and contextual baselib/Ground citations. Document reconciled with proposal; all seven supersessions accepted and eight compiled-evidence deferrals accepted. Supported unchanged research retained by inheritance, not independently re-audited.

proposed_facts.reason: Canonical signature, typedefs and invocation groups match the proposed explanation. Independently inspected baselib dispatch uses materially different argument lists; its signatures cannot establish local callback compatibility.

All twelve recognized cases attempt exactly one invocation, with the stated explicit arguments and payload dereferences; unsupported formats fall through without invocation. Compiled ABI delivery is appropriately deferred.
The recursive helper takes a prepared payload pointer, whereas the public entry decodes varargs. WithArgs meaningfully distinguishes these interfaces and addresses the rendered collision.
The callback captures one selected AObj and longjmps out of traversal. GetFirstAObj describes this search and avoids the canonical inline GetAObj accessor.
The predicate tests bit 26, explicitly defined as AOBJ_REWINDED. The interpreter sets it on looping wrap or clamp and clears it on the alternate branch, distinct from NO_ANIM.

Child recursion overwrites joint before the next-link test; exhaustion returns the reached pointer rather than a failure sentinel. The reset consumer shares its index with Ground lookup, whose explicit parent climbing demonstrates why arbitrary-tree equivalence is unsafe.

The complete body only performs a discarded shared-object lookup and archive assertion. Ground's surrounding light setup supports the light-path context; the proposed stub name avoids asserting animation mutation.

contradictions.reason: Accept the eight compiled-evidence deferrals: declarations, literal uses and switches do not prove section extents, sole contributions, placement, padding, or compiler-emitted branch tables. Preserve supported source-level purposes without promoting these layout claims.

Accept both dispatcher supersessions. Existing baselib-equivalent signature and payload explanations conflict with the local call expressions. Retain the explicit compiled-delivery uncertainty rather than assuming rendered wrapper names prove compatibility.

Accept the prepared-payload helper rename: the existing duplicate foreach name obscures a real interface distinction. Parser uncertainty remains a renderer concern, not evidence against the canonical distinction.
Accept the first-AObj search rename: the existing GetAObj name collides with a direct accessor and fails to convey early-exit hierarchy search.
Accept the rewound predicate rename: duplicate IsAnimFinished names conceal different tested bits. This is a first-selected-controller query, not proof that all hierarchy animations share a state.

Accept the descriptor-walk correction. Ordinary preorder wording omits cursor overwrite and incorrectly invites equivalence with the live lookup. Suitable archive structure and indices remain a caller dependency.
Accept the light archive validation-stub rename. The rendered SetLightAnim hypothesis implies mutation absent from the complete canonical body.
